opening.argument: The discussion explains StrongBlock nodes, the 10 STRONG contribution, recurring rewards, fees, token-price movements, and associated risks. It presents a possible recovery of the contribution over 100 days only if the price remains the same, while expressly stating, "But I can't guarantee you that, I'm sure." The presenter urges skepticism, acknowledges unresolved questions about STRONG, and tells viewers that they must consider the risks. Although he describes where he would buy after a positive retest and discusses his own investment, these conditional, qualified remarks do not promise a guaranteed outcome; they frame the subject as an investment discussion and tutorial with stated uncertainty.
